text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: All right, it's almost time. Everything's a-okay. Things will turn out differently than last time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Today's the day I run faster and freer than anyone's ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: There's just nothing worse than finishing a race and realizing you didn't have any fun at all, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Roger! I'm gonna go out there and have a blast!
